column1: # Every numeric level authored inside a library organ, with its disposition.
# THE LAW: a level is either read off the material or declared by the caller. It is never
# authored inside the organ. See canon/THE_AUTHORED_LEVEL.md.
# MATERIAL  a fact that cannot vary; `why` names the theorem.
# ABI       hardware, wire format, or foreign interface.
# APERTURE  declared, returns its outside, and `why` states what would derive it.
# PIN       a contaminant; `why` carries the excision plan.

EXCISE. Not a fact about quintics -- a REFUSAL GATE at :77 plus seven fixed-size-5 arrays including `type Permutation5 = [u8; 5]`. The organ cannot see a quartic or a sextic, so `solvable_by_radicals` refusing degree 5 has no degree to contrast against. Replace: read the degree off the polynomial; `Permutation5` -> a general permutation. `rational_polynomial.rs` already carries general-degree resultants and Sturm sequences.

the mode index is i+j over set bits of two u64 shape carriers (geom.rs:29,31), so ranks reach 0..=126 and the array must hold 127; the u64 shape word is the interface and no_std forbids alloc. 128 is a round-up -- the lawful spelling is 2*u64::BITS-1. Sizes a buffer; decides nothing. THE LEVEL THAT TRUNCATES IS THE BARE `while k < 64` AT geom.rs:50, which the regex cannot see.

a bit-field width of one packed u32: pack is flow | rmag<<13 | rrank<<26 (law.rs:104-106). SWEEP_RANK_TEETH = ceil(log2 u64::BITS) = 6 is the forced field; 13 = (u32::BITS-6)/2 under the declared equal split (law.rs:28-29). NOT a gear period -- nothing is taken mod 13. Defect: law.rs:58 derives the forced 6 FROM the two authored 13s, backwards; reverse the chain and one declared datum remains, the equal split.

nothing derives 31. The grip is a u32 bounded by axis^2 (place.rs:205); the pool's real boundary is pool.len(), caller-declared (manifold.rs:868) and ALREADY enforced as a refusal (law.rs:181,192,203,216,232). The mask's only effect is to ALIAS the top half of the grip space into the bottom (0x8000_0003 -> 3), turning a lawful refusal into a silent wrong return. EXCISION: delete `& POOL_MASK` from slot (law.rs:66). The comment's 'the card's own lawful maximum' is refuted -- that quantity is queried from the adapter at soma/surface/src/lib.rs:1759. Orbit exists only at axis = 2^16; at axis <= 2^15 the mask is the identity and the module's own test (law.rs:287, cell 999) cannot fail on it.

the same 13, asserted equal to FLOW_TEETH by the declared self-similarity at law.rs:28-29 -- the single piece of authored content in the packing, and the thing to attack. Decides a return: SWEEP_MASK sets the re-base point (law.rs:124) so windings keep 13 significant bits. law.rs:119's `rrank >= 64 - SWEEP_TEETH - 1` is a genuinely derived guard in the same file.
